reason: My POS mostly works and I have 11-20 techs, mostly older, who know it. Switching on a busy Saturday-driven business feels like all risk and little gain, even at $49.
objection: My staff are older, they will not learn a new system, and if checkout breaks on a Saturday I lose real money.
would_change_my_mind: A salon like mine with a similar size and staff already running it for months that I can visit or call, plus a run-alongside trial where I keep my current POS until my techs are comfortable.
